responsibility: Declares the Args module interface for bootstrapped GNU Modula-2 programs, exporting the routines that report the number of process command-line arguments and copy an individual argument into a caller-provided character array. This header defines the stable API layer above UnixArgs used by Modula-2 sources that want argv access without depending on the underlying C representation.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration-only interface for Args, publishing Args_GetArg and Args_Narg to users of the module. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GArgs.cc, it does not access UnixArgs or perform argv-to-buffer copying itself.
